packageRules.description: gh-aw generates .github/workflows/*.lock.yml via 'gh aw compile'. Their pinned action SHAs and container tags are managed by gh-aw (recompiling bumps them), so Renovate must not touch them: edits would be reverted on the next compile and can break the gh-aw integrity manifest.

grpc v1.84.x is affected by GO-2026-6443 (fixed in v1.82.2/v1.83.2; the advisory lists no fixed v1.84.x, only v1.85.0-dev). Skip the whole v1.84 line so automerge does not reintroduce the vulnerability; v1.85.0+ remains allowed.
